scope: Sargent and Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 1 (Finite States), Chapter 7: Nonlinear Valuation. Fixed points of order-preserving maps: Knaster-Tarski on order intervals of R^X, Du's theorem under all four conditions, the one-dimensional concave stability result with the Solow-Swan, Inada and Fajgelbaum et al. applications; the power-transformed affine equation v = [h + (Av)^(1/theta)]^theta with the shape of its scalar map and Theorem 7.1.4 (global stability iff rho(A)^(1/theta) < 1); the Kleinman et al. consumption-rate equation; time additive, risk-sensitive and Epstein-Zin lifetime utility, the entropic risk-adjusted expectation and its Gaussian and Jensen properties; certainty equivalent operators (linear, entropic, Kreps-Porteus, quantile) and their additivity, convexity and monotonicity; aggregators and Koopmans operators, the elasticity of intertemporal substitution, finite-horizon values, monotone lifetime values, the Blackwell-type condition, quantile and Uzawa preferences, and Epstein-Zin preferences with state-dependent discounting via topological conjugacy; with the provable exercises.
source: Thomas J. Sargent and John Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 1: Finite States, Chapter 7, pp. 213-245.
